environment: Node.js local immutable ESA Gaia DR3 snapshot
assumptions: High signal-to-noise random-index sample only, not a census.
Inverse-parallax distance approximations, no Bayesian distance inference.
ICRS J2016.0 sky directions; no proper-motion or epoch propagation.
No scientific manual review required; software field consistency is checked.

checks.name: manifest identifies official Gaia DR3 and J2016.0 ICRS
four raw ESA TAP snapshots match SHA-256 and row counts
raw Gaia CSV slice 00 matches recorded checksum
raw Gaia CSV slice 01 matches recorded checksum
raw Gaia CSV slice 02 matches recorded checksum
raw Gaia CSV slice 03 matches recorded checksum
static near chunk matches checksum and byte size
static mid chunk matches checksum and byte size
static far chunk matches checksum and byte size
distance conversion refuses low SNR or negative parallax
ICRS to scene axes have normalized directions
near block is loaded lazily and independently
mid block adds only its Gaia sources
full sample has exactly 2057 distinct immutable source identifiers
records preserve 64-bit ID and measured Gaia values
magnitude, distance and exact-source search are repeatable
catalog scene positions do not mutate source coordinates
